# OpenProgram 1.4.0 Release Notes

OpenProgram 1.4.0 keeps several keys and sign-ins per provider and moves to the next one when a limit is hit, groups a reply's work into task blocks, gives scheduled tasks a run history, and keeps a conversation on one line with the view at its latest message. Releases are published from `Fzkuji/OpenProgram` from this version on. Which packages this release carries is listed under "Download and installation".

## ✨ New features

- **Several credentials per provider.** API keys and sign-ins sit in one ordered list per provider. A conversation keeps the one it started with, and a rate limit, a spent quota or a refused key moves it to the next, with one line in the conversation. Settings shows each list with status and usage and lets you reorder, rename, check, replace, pause and remove entries; the model menu shows which key a conversation uses.
- **One card per company.** A company you connect to in more than one way is one card in LLM Providers: OpenAI shows its ChatGPT subscription and its API as two sections, each with its own status, quota, usage and Add button. The list view, the model menu ("OpenAI · ChatGPT") and `openprogram providers status` group the same way.
- **Task blocks in a reply.** The agent names a task and its steps; each step holds the searches, edits and interim text done for it. A running block shows the step it is on, a finished one folds to one line with its outcome, and the Goal chip shows the current step and jumps to the open block. Progress rides on the calls the agent already makes, so moving through steps costs no extra model round trips.
- **One todo list per reply.** A reply shows one list instead of a card per item, todos of one Goal are one list, and the model can write a whole plan in one call.
- **Scheduled tasks have a history.** A scheduled task is one row in Agents with its title, its number of runs, how many did not finish, and a strip of its last 24 runs. Its page lists runs by day with length and result; a run that failed or was stopped says why and lists its helpers. A weekly, monthly or yearly schedule reads in words ("Mondays at 09:30").
- **Memory files notes by meaning.** A company, person, paper or project with more than one note becomes a folder named after it, and the nightly organiser regroups flat folders with links following. `openprogram memory regroup` applies a move list.
- **A sign-in step that explains the choices.** A provider's sign-in lists its ways to connect with the recommended one first and a line about each. Usage in the model menu shows each limit with its reset time and percent over a full-width bar.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- **Conversations keep one line.** A turn advances its own branch, a late finish never moves the conversation back, and a Goal continues after its last reply instead of opening a branch each round. Goal and background-command turns take the run slot, so they no longer overlap, and the sidebar, the Stop button and Activity show them running, also after a reload.
- **Goals.** A Goal stopped by hand stays stopped, and a background command that ends during a Goal is reported in the Goal's next turn. A turn in flight no longer shows as a second branch in Activity.
- **The view stays where you put it.** Opening or switching to a conversation lands at the latest message with a fixed gap above the composer. The chat no longer pulls the view to the bottom when you stop a little short of it, and a window made shorter keeps the last message above the composer.
- **Credentials.** Keys carried over from earlier versions are all kept, a key the list already holds is not added again on each start, and a key check shows the provider's own reason with the key cut out.
- **Errors say what failed.** A turn that fails the moment it starts reports its own error instead of a lookup failure.
- **Menus and dialogs.** Dragging a scrollbar inside a menu or dialog no longer closes it, a menu whose button leaves the screen hides at once, and the Settings shortcut opens Settings.
- `openprogram programs check` examines the working copy even when the package's checked version no longer imports.
- Removing a scheduled task leaves a record in the Worker log, and the list as it was is kept beside the new one.

## 🚀 Improvements

- **Activity opens at once.** A conversation's runs are listed from one read, so a conversation with two hundred runs answers in a fifth of a second instead of four to six, and returning to a conversation draws its last list in the first frame.
- **A quieter idle Worker.** An idle Worker no longer reads every conversation's log again every five seconds in a store of more than 512 conversations.
- **Faster sending.** A sent message no longer jumps or fades in twice, and sending redraws only what changed.
- **Split panes close in the same frame**, with the save and release of the file done afterwards. Dialogs dim the page without blurring it.
- **"Jump to latest"** rides to the end over a fixed half second, lands on the newest message even while a reply is growing, appears only after scrolling up a real distance, and is drawn in the theme colour.
- **Provider logos.** Perplexity Agent, the Kimi code plans, the StepFun step plans, Tencent TokenHub, Azure Cognitive Services and Xiaomi show their company's logo instead of a letter, and the providers list view shows status, plan and quota whole.
- **Diagnostics.** The Worker log records which code held a conversation for a second or more and where the Worker was when it stopped answering.
- The Goal chip under the composer has the same framed look as the chips beside it.

On macOS, open the DMG and copy `OpenProgram.app` to `/Applications`. On Windows, run the installer; it installs for your user only. The release manifest lists the SHA-256 of every file. A file whose name ends in `-unsigned` was built without a publisher signature; see "Unsigned packages" below when that applies.

### CLI / Server

Install this release on macOS or Linux; the installer selects the architecture and verifies the runtime:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://fzkuji.github.io/OpenProgram/install | OPENPROGRAM_VERSION=1.4.0 sh
```

On Windows x64, in PowerShell:

```powershell
irm https://fzkuji.github.io/OpenProgram/install.ps1 | iex
```

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- **Desktop, from 1.3.0 or earlier:** download the package above and install it over the existing App once. Releases moved to `Fzkuji/OpenProgram` with this version, and an earlier App looks for updates where it was built, so **Check for updates** does not find 1.4.0.
- **Desktop on macOS:** open the DMG and replace the application in `/Applications`.
- **Desktop on Linux:** install the AppImage or deb above in place of the old one.
- **Desktop on Windows:** run the installer above; it installs over the existing App and keeps your data.
- **CLI / Server:** run `openprogram upgrade`, or repeat the versioned installation command above.
- **Your data:** configuration, conversations, Programs, and saved progress under `~/.openprogram` are preserved.
- **After upgrading:** check `openprogram --version`.

See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/Fzkuji/OpenProgram/blob/v1.4.0/docs/install/upgrade.html) for details.
